India tells UN Pakistan's civilian govt serves at Army's mercy

India's Permanent Representative to the UN, Ruchira Kamboj, stated at the UN that Pakistan's civilian governments operate at the mercy of its army. This statement was made in response to Pakistan's Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif's remarks at the UN General Assembly. India accused Pakistan of being the epicenter of terrorism and a sponsor of cross-border terrorism. India also highlighted Pakistan's economic crisis, stating that its people are suffering due to its policies.
